T0524.title: Webhook
T0524.definition: An event callback delivered over HTTP from one system to another when a business event occurs.
T0524.description: Webhooks push business events to other systems, so the receiver must validate origin, signatures, replay windows, destination configuration, and retry behavior. Poorly configured webhooks can enable forged callbacks, replayed events, SSRF abuse, or sensitive-data leakage through callbacks. Controls focus on signature verification, idempotent event handling, destination allowlists, and audit trails.
T0524.usageExample: Assess Webhook related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
